title: What changes when your output becomes other people’s output

videos.script: Two weeks ago Renata was a senior engineer. Today she manages the team she used to work in. {{title}} At the end of her first Friday she has merged nothing, closed nothing and fixed nothing. She feels she wasted the week. {{friday}} She did not. Her output is now the team's output, and that is measured in a different way. {{grove}} This lesson is about what that changes. Where your hours go, and why they arrive in small pieces. {{calendar}} Why the answer to anything you decide now takes weeks to come back. {{loops}} What to do in the first ninety days, and what to leave alone. {{tour}} And the notebook you will keep for the rest of the course. There is nothing to install. You need somewhere to write, somewhere to count, and somewhere to draw. {{notebook}} Every lesson follows Renata and her team at a company called Caju. The mistakes are hers. The lessons are for you.
